hints.title: Zero Parameter Check
hints.text: If k is 0, replace every element with 0.

hints.title: Determine Initial Window Range
hints.text: If k > 0, the first window covers indices 1 to k. If k < 0, the window covers n + k to n - 1.

hints.title: Slide Circular Window
hints.text: Slide the window across the circular array by adding the entering element and subtracting the exiting element.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def decrypt(self, code: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        n = len(code)
        res = [0] * n
        if k == 0:
            return res
        start, end = (1, k) if k > 0 else (n + k, n - 1)
        w_sum = sum(code[i % n] for i in range(start, end + 1))
        for i in range(n):
            res[i] = w_sum
            w_sum -= code[start % n]
            start += 1
            end += 1
            w_sum += code[end % n]
        return res
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing k elements from scratch for each position takes O(n * |k|).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window technique achieves optimal O(n) time with O(n) result storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle negative k circular index wrap-around accurately.
